verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bitwarden generates TOTP codes in its integrated authenticator and that a separate Authenticator app can import codes and optionally sync with Password Manager. Nothing documents that codes are generated fully offline or that they can be viewed without a vendor account. Self-hosting and the CLI are adjacent and still assume a vault account, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes
